caption:
A resolved ticket is not always a fixed one. 👀

An AI agent answers a billing question. The customer says thanks. The ticket closes. That counts as a win in the dashboard right now.

The next morning the same customer writes in again. Same account, same charge, still wrong. This time a human has to actually fix it.

Two tickets now exist for one problem. The first one is still sitting in the resolved column, exactly as it was the moment it closed. 📊

Most ROI dashboards never catch this. They measure a moment, not an outcome. Closed and held are not the same claim. 💡

The fix is simple: track a held rate. Only count a ticket as resolved if the customer never has to come back within a set window.

agentworth's audit log links every recontact back to the original ticket, so a resolution only counts once it actually holds. 🎯

Save this for your next ROI review, or tag someone who owns that number. 📌
